name: reversal_volatility_tier_high_0_q
rationale: High-vol tier bleeds (-0.22R); tightening the max ATR extension gate should filter overextended, gappy reversals that dominate the high-vol bucket and drag expectancy.

name: reversal_market_trend_bull_1_q
rationale: The bull-trend sample is large (n=288) but only marginally positive; requiring a deeper/longer pullback before a reversal entry should skip shallow bounces and lift expectancy above the CI bound.

name: reversal_score_0_00_0_50_2_q
rationale: Low score bucket (0.00-0.50) is where nearly all reversals live and is barely breakeven; demanding a more extreme oversold read should concentrate entries into genuine capitulation reversals.
